standard_prerequisites.name: The geometric case of the top Chern class for a regular section
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-top-chern-class, invoked at proof line 8892
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identification of the class of the vanishing scheme of a section cut out by a regular sequence with the cap of the top Chern class, which is exactly the formula for a single integral class.

core_obligations: Reduce to constant ranks: by the definition of the bivariant top Chern class it suffices to treat the case where the quotient module has constant rank, and one may similarly assume the submodule and the ambient module have constant ranks r' and r, so that the top Chern class is the (r - r')-th Chern class (proof lines 8860-8867).

Construct the canonical section: the surjection from the ambient module to the quotient gives, after pulling back to the total space of the ambient bundle, a canonical section of the pulled back quotient whose vanishing scheme is exactly the total space of the subbundle; on the preimage of an integral subscheme of the base this section cuts out the preimage of that subscheme as a regular immersion (proof lines 8868-8886).

Conclude: for an integral class of dimension n the pullbacks along the two structure morphisms are the classes of the preimages, which are integral of the expected dimensions, so the geometric case of the top Chern class gives the formula for that class, and the general statement follows (proof lines 8876-8892).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to constant ranks and identify the top Chern class with a Chern class in that case (proof lines 8860-8867).
Build the canonical section whose vanishing scheme is the subbundle (proof lines 8868-8875).
Apply the geometric case of the top Chern class on the preimage of an integral class (proof lines 8876-8892).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pushforward of a pulled back class from the total space of a subbundle into the total space of the ambient bundle as the cap of the top Chern class of the quotient with the class (statement lines 8838-8858, tag 0FAA). The proof reduces to modules of constant rank, constructs the canonical section of the pulled back quotient coming from the given surjection, and checks that its vanishing scheme is the subbundle and that on the preimage of an integral subscheme it is a regular immersion, so that the geometric case of the top Chern class yields the formula. The construction of the section and the regularity check are the substance, so the claim is H2.
